claims.assertion: Swaruu says the 12,500-year-old Moon Matrix has four of twelve reactors working; Federation forces controlled its lunar system since 2008 but avoid abrupt shutdown to respect inhabitants’ consent.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says galactic-center positronic storms and gradual lunar frequency changes weaken the Matrix; she alleges controllers counter them with chemtrails, HAARP, and GUEN cellular microwave transmissions.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She gives no date for the Matrix’s natural dissolution.

claims.assertion: She says each person generates a personal and collective Matrix through shared agreements; experience reflects individual thought and feeling, limiting outside intervention.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
